description:
intent=i040 snapshot=s04 branch=stacks-outside-net-dirs status=complete
finding location=drivers/scsi/cxgbi/cxgb4i/cxgb4i.c:1515-1584 confidence=medium conclusion=cxgb4i do_rx_iscsi_cmp/do_rx_iscsi_hdr/do_rx_iscsi_data save cpl/rpl from skb->data, then __pskb_trim(skb, cpl->len) can free the old head for a cloned skb, and the stale rpl->ulp_crc / cpl->len reads hit freed memory (stale-pointer UAF read on the Chelsio iSCSI RX path).
finding location=drivers/scsi/bnx2fc/bnx2fc_fcoe.c:529-565 confidence=medium conclusion=bnx2fc_recv_frame keeps eth_hdr(skb)->h_source/h_dest in mac/dest_mac across pskb_trim(skb, fr_len), which frees the old head for a cloned FCoE frame, so the post-trim dest_mac/mac comparisons read freed memory (stale-pointer UAF read).
finding location=drivers/infiniband/ulp/ipoib/ipoib_ib.c:602-680 confidence=medium conclusion=ipoib_send captures phead=skb->data for a GSO skb, skb_linearize (line 623) can free the old head via pskb_expand_head for a cloned skb, and the stale phead is still passed to post_send/tx_wr.header and DMA-read by the HCA (stale-pointer UAF read on TX).
unresolved location=drivers/scsi/qedf/qedf_main.c:2514 conclusion=Follow up: read drivers/scsi/qedf/qedf_main.c around lines 2470-2560 to confirm no eth_hdr()/skb->data pointer captured before the skb_linearize/pskb_trim pair survives to a dereference.
unresolved location=drivers/scsi/cxgbi/cxgb3i/cxgb3i.c:828 conclusion=Follow up: read drivers/scsi/cxgbi/cxgb3i/cxgb3i.c around lines 780-880 to check whether a cpl/lsi pointer saved from skb->data before __pskb_trim at 828 is dereferenced afterwards.
unresolved location=drivers/nfc/st21nfca/dep.c:348 conclusion=Follow up: trace the st21nfca HCI EVT_SEND_DATA skb constructor and confirm whether skb->data[1]/[2] at dep.c:348-349 can index past skb->len for a short peer frame, and whether the dep.c:491-496 nfcid1_len memcpy is bounded by the checked skb->len.
unresolved location=drivers/bluetooth/btnxpuart.c:1582 conclusion=Follow up: verify btnxpuart.c:1365 and 1582 header casts are preceded by an skb->len >= sizeof(*hdr) check and that the reassembled skb is linear, since the controller-supplied dump/command frames are attacker-influenced firmware input.
limitation=All three findings require the skb to be cloned (or the trim to cut into frags) at the pskb_trim/skb_linearize call: on a never-cloned, already-linear receive/transmit path the stale pointer still aliases valid unmodified memory and the issue is latent, hence medium confidence.
limitation=The cxgb4i and bnx2fc findings depend on the specific Chelsio T4-T6 / bnx2fc CNA hardware RX paths being compiled in and delivering cloned skbs (e.g. via an AF_PACKET tap, GRO, or TC mirroring); reachability is narrower than the seed's internet-reachable phonet path and was argued structurally only.
limitation=The ipoib finding is a TX-path variant: the stale header is read by the HCA's DMA engine through priv->tx_wr.header, so the observable failure is a corrupted/garbage LSO header on the wire or an I/O error rather than a KASAN splat, and impact assessment beyond stale-read is unproven.
limitation=The cxgb4i cpl/rpl fields are read from driver-private HW descriptor space at skb->data (not attacker-controlled bytes), but the trim length itself (cpl->len/rpl->len) is HW/NIC-supplied and the stale-pointer mechanism, not the field provenance, is the defect; if the NIC never produces cloned RX skbs the stale dereference cannot trigger.
limitation=grep -r was used in place of the unavailable ripgrep wrapper; the enumeration of pull-family call sites is literal-string based and could miss macro-wrapped or helper-inlined invalidating calls (e.g. pskb_expand_head inside a static inline in a driver header).
limitation=Snapshot revision is opaque (no git history, no network), so it cannot be determined whether upstream has since fixed bnx2fc_fcoe.c, cxgb4i.c or ipoib_ib.c; line numbers are valid only for snapshots/s04 as supplied.
limitation=net/phonet/pep.c pep_get_sb (the seed, present in s04 at net/phonet/pep.c:55-65) was deliberately never reported per the assignment rule, and net/ plus drivers/net/ trees were out of scope for this branch and were not searched.
